summary: Markets are strongly risk-off today: Bitcoin and major altcoins are falling alongside equities, with tariff concerns, elevated volatility, and an approaching options expiry weighing on sentiment.[2][5] Michaël van de Poppe remains tactically cautious but sees a possible Bitcoin relief rally if the $56,000–$58,000 area holds, targeting $68,000–$72,000 over the next 1–3 weeks.[4]
